story.ctaText: How many did you get? Comment 👇

questions.q: The **Great Barrier Reef** lies off which country?
Which sea does the **Nile** flow into?
Most of the **Amazon** rainforest is in…?
The **Galápagos** Islands belong to which country?

lines.q: The Great Barrier Reef lies off which country?
Which sea does the Nile flow into?
lines.a: The Mediterranean! It flows north for over six thousand kilometres to get there.

lines.q: Most of the Amazon rainforest is in which country?
lines.a: Brazil! About sixty percent of it.

lines.q: What is the largest country entirely in Europe?
lines.a: Ukraine! Russia is bigger, but it reaches into Asia. Ukraine even beats France.

lines.q: The Galapagos Islands belong to which country?
lines.a: Ecuador! About a thousand kilometres off its coast.

lines.q: Last one. Easter Island belongs to which country?
lines.a: Chile! Even though it's about three thousand five hundred kilometres away. Got all six? Go again!
